steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: So you're able to move around without your wheelchair now?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Yes, I've been rehabilitating pretty well.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Last year, they had a wheelchair rapid-firing contest, which I won... and then the doctors banned me from competing again.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: We'd have to look for a Gun-Knight to beat your firing skills, I think.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Aww, that's nice to hear.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'd be even happier if SOMEONE learned how to say a few nice words to the sick, like my darling Fiammetta here.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Mostima, are you just going to stand there pretending you're the curtains?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You know I'm not the type, Lemuen.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: What type? This is your first time back in two or three years. My memory's not that good.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Fine. Lemuen fires better than anyone I know. Her skills are incredible.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Mm-hm, that's more like it.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Is El doing alright in Lungmen?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I saw her recently. She's doing great.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You'd better worry about yourself before her.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: And I'll copy those words right back at you.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: How long are you going to stay this time?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Dunno, really. But it'll be at least until the conference's over, Wednesday after next, I think?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Tuesday after.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh, Tuesday. Otherwise, it's up to how that old weirdo feels. Who knows if he'll send me on some weird and wacky assignment again.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Did you just call His Holiness...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: He's not gonna mind, Fiammetta.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: If you want to stay for a bit longer, I could help you there.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That so.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Did you figure it out already?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Figure what out? What are you two talking about?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Did you really not realize, Fiammetta?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Who we've been handing our reports to for the last half year?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Was it that obvious?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Wh-What...? Wait, Lemuen... you got a job at the Lateran Curia? While you're still in rehab...?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Don't worry, it's just some secretary work.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How long will you stick with it?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm not sure yet.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Will you return to the Guard?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Little chance of that now.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Your marksmanship, overlooked just like that... it's a mind-boggling waste.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You judge me so highly, Fiammetta, even though I messed it all up.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: That wasn't your fault.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: And it wasn't yours either.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Don't stretch yourself too thin.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: The day will come when I settle the matter with him.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Oh, well. Mostima...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Can I rub your horns?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Spoilsport.
Lemuen gazes out the window as Mostima stands beside it, idly playing with the flowers in her hands.
In a flash, Fiammetta returns to a time before.
The sun shines ever bright and beautiful during a Lateran springtime, and a hint of chill rides the air.
Through the window, she spots the roofs of church buildings large and small. Here and there, now and then, fowlbeasts streak across the sky.
Lemuen is peaceful in any ordinary time, occasionally uttering a remark or two. Around her, the atmosphere softens.
The standoffish Mostima relaxes without realizing, unable to sense the smile she lets slip.
Just as always.
As if none of it ever happened.
But it's only an illusion.
After that night, not a night more could she soundly sleep.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Lemuen...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Something's on my mind, Lemuen.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Does this hospital have all that many volunteers?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Hm? I suppose.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Conscientious Doctor
steps.text: Seniora Lemuen, I want you to look at this...

steps.name: Conscientious Doctor
steps.text: Oh, you have visitors?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: It's alright, they're old war buddies of mine.

steps.name: Conscientious Doctor
steps.text: War buddies... you don't mean—!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Conscientious Doctor
steps.text: In that case, maybe all three of you could take a look at these test results...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Oren, do you know what you're doing?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Maybe you'll be kind enough to tell me?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: She's not going to think of your methods as just 'personal conduct.'

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: She'll be thinking we're going out of our way to exhibit 'the Lateran stance.'

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Slip up for a moment and this becomes a diplomatic incident.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Isn't that exactly what you want?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Conflict leads to issues, issues require resolution, resolution needs a channel.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Laterano's providing a whole new way to resolve issues.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: And we provide this method under two prerequisites—what we say has to carry enough weight, and what we say has to be 'appropriate'.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Right, Laterano needs to have an 'appropriate stance.' If all we brought to the table was an ordinary roll of the dice, who'd need Laterano?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: —Wouldn't you say, Your Holiness?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Do you agree with him, Vel?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: He's pretending to be smart.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The reason Laterano stands upon this land, and the reason the Legati can cross all borders, is that Laterano possesses faith.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: No, it's because of Laterano itself that the Legati are given passage, Your Eminence.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: We all know clear as day that the true Lateran faith can't reach beyond the Sankta. I'm sorry, but it might let you down if you count on it to get things done.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Oren, if you seek death, you can apply through the proper channels.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Truthfully, I've never understood how you two manage to fight so much.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: When I set out on my way back from Victoria to Laterano, Duke Gododdin asked me a question, and I believe it's not one I'm equipped to answer.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: He asked: 'Does anywhere in Laterano suffice to draw me there?'

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Your Holiness, when we're sat at the playing table, will the cards in our hand be enough?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Your Holiness, Mostima wishes to speak with you.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: She states that what she must report cannot be heard by any other.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Then we'll step outta your hair.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: You may go.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Put her through.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Time sure does fly, Your Holiness.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: A good while, my child. Is Lemuen well?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No hiding anything from you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We've seen something interesting here at this hospital.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I saw the results of a physical checkup, and some of the signs look verrrry familiar.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Say no more before you return to the Basilica, Mostima.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Understood. Fiammetta'll go find the person these results belong to.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I know the hospital Lemuen's recovering at is in... Pagus Stevonus.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Stevonus.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Something that'd make Mostima use a dedicated line...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Oh, quit messing with me.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Cecelia, do you feel alright?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: My head really hurt before... It's a bit better now.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: In that case, I'll carry you out.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Out...? Who are you?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: We're your companions, Cecelia. There's someone waiting for you.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'm afraid it's not her.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Your mother won't come back, Cecelia.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'm sorry, I can't explain it to you.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: But someone can. I'll take you to see him.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I'm sorry, Miss, but I want to find Mamma first.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'm really not good with kids. Sorry, Cecelia, whether you want to or not, I have to bring you away. You aren't safe here.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Grr, too quick...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Who are you? What are you doing with Cecelia?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Not for you to know, Sankta.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Cecelia was a companion of ours from the start. You're the one stealing her away.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: In that case, please tell me her parents' family name, her home address, identity number, and your blood or legal relationship to her.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Ugh, Notarial Hall brainrot.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: If you have proper grounds to leave with Cecelia, you can tell me, and I'll take it into account in my decision.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: If you were a Liberi, I'd consider it. But Sankta like you... no chance.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You bear the Lateran symbol. You're a Liberi of Laterano yourself. Why hate the Sankta?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Lemme tell you something, you Notarial Hall scumbag.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: The thing I hate second most in my life is when people like you—selfishly assume—it has to be a law of nature that every Liberi who lives in Laterano gets along great with Sankta!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: If you don't plan on elucidating your grounds, I won't let you take Cecelia.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Not your call.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'll hold him off. You take Cecelia.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Sorry, Cecelia. Just bear with it.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: ...I don't want to.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What's happening?! What was that explosion? And the smoke?!

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: The window...! It must've been when...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: There was a strong gust of wind just now. I'll close the window, in case she'd catch a cold.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Goddamned executor!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'll give you a word of advice! If you truly care about Cecelia, then don't give her up to the Notarial Hall or the Lateran Curia! Or else, you'll regret it!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia, hold on tight.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Good. We need to break free of them, then.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Is he going to listen...?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Of course he won't. Sankta are a bunch of happy-go-lucky idiots, but the ones at the Notarial Hall don't even get the 'happy-go-lucky' part.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Whether he listens or not, we need to ensure Cecelia is... in our hands before we can proceed.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Then we need to notify the others ASAP.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Already done.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: While I was talking to him just now.

steps.name: Amiable Hospital Attendant
steps.text: Ooh—you wanted to hold him up so you could send word out...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: He can't outrun us.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Why was the door to this ward open?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Wh... Is that you, Patia?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Was there an eight-year-old Sankta girl staying in this ward?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I heard an explosion on the way here. Did you have something to do with that?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What's so weird about explosions in Laterano?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Are you really the Patia I know?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Fiammetta. The girl you're looking for's already out of hospital.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: (She's definitely not here...)

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Why are you here?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What, you get to show up in Stevonus Central Hospital, but I don't?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Are the Guard looking for this girl too? Where'd you get this information?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I left the Pontifica Cohors long ago. Weren't you off being a Legatus's bodyguard? What, now you're back in Laterano again looking for some Sankta girl?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Don't you just love being surrounded by Sankta?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Liberi like you are all...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Patia. What's happened to you since I left?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Don't ask that like you actually care.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Enough. You don't need to talk to me like that.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: If the girl's not here, I don't need to waste any more time with you either.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Forget what happened to me. You should be wondering just what you're doing, Fiammetta... Miss Veteran.
Tsk-tsk, Patia. Here I thought you loved your precious Fiammetta. Here you are with her again of all the things, and this is how cruel you treat her?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What's it to you? And what about the Notarial Hall kid? What's your plan?
Don't get so gruff, Patia. I might have an even better solution.
But I'll need another small favor from you.
